package.name: bridge_sector_tuner_3d
package.description: Bridge centerline / heading-lock sector tuner. Operates on the smoothed centerline CSV (pre-optimization), not on the raceline waypoints. Produces per-map bridge_sectors.yaml that the racing-line optimizer consumes to either pin n=0 (force_center) or bound abs(chi) below chi_max inside bridge zones (with optional pre/post extension).
